anatomy.reason: Both views show two slender tentacles with basal eyes, but the shell centres appear raised rather than sunken, especially in the three-quarter view.

style.reason: Dark outlines and marker texture are present, but extensive gradients and glossy highlights exceed the requested flat two-to-three-tone treatment.

no_slop.reason: There is no cute face, smile, decoration, text, extra appendage or obvious rendering artefact.

layout.reason: The light background supports a left side view and right three-quarter view at consistent shell height and with matching colours.

fix: Recess both coil centres, make the three-quarter shell read as a narrow planispiral disc, and replace glossy gradients with two or three flat marker-textured tones.
overall: A coherent design that needs clearer planispiral shell anatomy and flatter colouring to meet the brief.
